title: Bot VTOL pick-up ends when the BattleArmor stops wanting the ride (RideIntent, 2026-11-12)

facts.title: A bot BattleArmor's lift request outlived its intent: the VTOL chased / hovered over a BattleArmor that was fighting (RideIntent)
facts.fact: A bot BattleArmor re-posts its lift request (g_lift, live 3 s) on every evaluation its objective is over 250 m away and nobody is shooting at it, whatever goal it then picks; so while it fought someone else or ran for a power-up, a VTOL kept taking the request, flying to it and hovering over it (v29h1 NRC CTF: VTOL bot 10 t=101.6-110.7 from 258 to 48 m, then 4 s hovering 70-78 m off while BA bot 8 peeked and shot; v29h2: VTOL bot 2 t=113-119 behind BA bot 4 on a power-up run). RideIntent adds g_lift.want_t: the requester stamps it at the end of each evaluation whose goal is ride, or objective without a give-up (lift_off) on the VTOL coming; a VTOL skips (and drops its claim on) a bot's request whose stamp is over 2 s old, and takes it again once it is fresh. The player's requests (no brain) always count.
facts.how_to_use: Switch RideIntent / RECOMP_BOT_RIDE_INTENT (default on). [C7] rideintent: ended, claims_dropped; diag [BOT-RIDEINTENT] (RECOMP_BOT_DIAG). Commit fcab54e on v29-vtol; shipped in 1.0.7 (rc31).
